title: a learning block's traces berth under the device that holds it
intention: cairn.machines.learning_block addresses every trace by its holder: trace_root(holder) is instance_path(<device>, <n>)/machines/learning_block/traces, every writer and reader names the holder it serves (or an explicit root), a call naming neither is refused, and a migrate verb moves the flat ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces files to their holders.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: learning_block is a shared machine held by the librarian, CodeMother and the web server, and outline 16.4.3 (with CLAUDE.md's three roots) puts a held machine's data under its holder. Every trace instead sits at ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces, an instance space for a device that does not exist, so no holder can tell its own learning from another's and a second holder instance would mix with the first. Found while fixing the same drift in e889b197a3f6's floor (open-d5cfd943a2ab); the orchestrator asked for it to be cast.
traces_to: Law 6 (a held machine's state is the holder's to own and gate, berthed under the holder that assembled it) and Law 1 (one address resolver, not the flat path spelled again in two probes).
how: D1: learning_block.py: trace_root(holder) parses '<device>/<n>' and returns instance_path(device, n)/machines/learning_block/traces (CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT still overrides, flat, for proofs); trace_path, trace_lines, write_trace, traced, read_trace, fire_door and dial take holder=, and with neither holder nor root raise TraceRefused naming holder; trace_roots() lists every holder's trace dir; BLOCK_HOLDERS maps the flat files to holders. D2: engine.run_block passes holder= through. D3: the shell door takes --holder <device>/<n> on trace and dial (refused without), and a migrate verb moves each mapped flat file into its holder's file (appending, no line twice), removes the flat file, and leaves and names any unmapped one. D4: skill_block.SKILL_HOLDER='cc/0' rides fire and skilldial; the skill doors and refusal probes name it. D5: each device writer names itself (librarian, codemother clearance, web_server), the compiler cairn/0, superclaude cc/0, logger_for_bash cairn/0; tellmeabout and the corpus probe walk trace_roots(). D6: the proof. Holders: librarian-ask -> librarian/0 (8.5); harbor_master__clearance -> codemother/0 (9.4.1.4); web_server -> web_server/0 (15.4); intentions_model_compiler -> cairn/0 (17.12, its user is Cairn); logger_for_bash -> cairn/0 (bin is Cairn's own); superclaude -> cc/0 (10.3.2); every skill:*, skill__*, sail:* and fable:* block -> cc/0 (16.3.3, skill_block is CC's for now).

clauses.claim: under a scratch HOME, write_trace('b', ..., holder='librarian/0') lands at <HOME>/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/machines/learning_block/traces/b.jsonl, read_trace, trace_lines and dial with the same holder read it back, and nothing is created under <HOME>/.cairn/devices/learning_block

write_trace, read_trace, trace_lines, dial, fire_door, traced and run_block called with neither holder nor root raise TraceRefused naming holder and write nothing; the shell door's trace and dial without --holder exit 2

no class-space source outside cairn/machines/learning_block/ (proofs, validations and history excluded) spells devices/learning_block, and every shell-door call in cairn/devices/cc/superclaude and bin/logger_for_bash passes --holder

migrate over a scratch flat root moves each BLOCK_HOLDERS block's lines into its holder's file, appended to lines already there with no line twice, removes the flat file, and leaves an unmapped block's file in place, naming it; a second migrate moves nothing
cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py and cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/ stay green over the change

decisions.text: D1: learning_block.py: trace_root(holder) -> instance_path(device, int(n)) / 'machines' / 'learning_block' / 'traces', holder '<device>/<n>' else TraceRefused; CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT overrides flat; trace_path/legacy_trace_path/trace_lines/write_trace/traced/read_trace/fire_door/dial gain holder: str | None = None and resolve root if given else trace_root(holder), refusing neither; trace_roots() globs instance root devices/*/*/machines/learning_block/traces; BLOCK_HOLDERS: librarian-ask -> librarian/0 (8.5); harbor_master__clearance -> codemother/0 (9.4.1.4); web_server -> web_server/0 (15.4); intentions_model_compiler -> cairn/0 (17.12, its user is Cairn); logger_for_bash -> cairn/0 (bin is Cairn's own); superclaude -> cc/0 (10.3.2); every skill:*, skill__*, sail:* and fable:* block -> cc/0 (16.3.3, skill_block is CC's for now); the module docstring names the new address.
D2: engine.py run_block(spec, payload, *, holder=None, root=None, ...) passes holder to every write_trace.

D3: __main__.py: trace and dial require --holder <device>/<n> (exit 2 without); new verb migrate [--from <flat root>] (default the old instance_path('learning_block',0)/traces) moving each BLOCK_HOLDERS file to trace_path(block, holder=...), appending only lines not already there, deleting the flat file, printing moved and unmapped. Its neighbouring proof test_learning_block.py's shell-door tooth passes --holder cc/0, since a holderless trace now exits 2.

D4: skill_block.py SKILL_HOLDER = 'cc/0' (outline 16.3.3) passed to fire_door; skilldial.py reads with it; skills intent/sorted/saveslate/design door.py pass it on their direct write_trace calls; skills intent/sorted/saveslate refusal probes read through trace_lines(holder=SKILL_HOLDER), the sorted and saveslate probes losing their own spelled default; tellmeabout.py walks trace_roots(). The tellmeabout proof walks trace_roots() for findings.

D5: holders named at each writer and reader: cairn/devices/librarian/ask.py and probes/ask_spares_akien.py 'librarian/0'; cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/clearance.py 'codemother/0'; cairn/devices/web_server/server.py 'web_server/0'; cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/compiler.py 'cairn/0'; cairn/devices/cc/superclaude --holder cc/0; bin/logger_for_bash --holder cairn/0; probes/engine_trace_corpus.py walks trace_roots(). address.py's docstring (its census table and the drift paragraph) spelled the flat address; it is reworded as history, naming this ticket. The clearance and web_server proofs read their queue and wire under their holders.
D6: proof test_traces_berth_under_their_holder.py, one tooth per clause, every write under a scratch HOME (subprocess env) or scratch root; clause 5 runs the two named proof sets.

out: running migrate on a live box: an act after PROVED, once the holders' long-running devices restart on the new code
